name: Catamaran Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Catamaran (investment manager Catamaran Ventures LLP), the Bengaluru family office that manages the assets of Infosys founder N. R. Narayana Murthy and his family. Its site is catamaran.in: catamaranventures.com 301-redirects there over HTTP, and its HTTPS endpoint fails TLS. The site footer names the SEBI Category II AIFs Catamaran AIF Trust I and Catamaran Ekam. Press (ET Apr 2025, Moneycontrol Jul 2026, Bloomberg via Channel IAM Oct 2026) describes the same firm moving into precision manufacturing, deep tech, intelligent manufacturing (robotics, predictive maintenance) and enterprise AI. That fits the list's 'Automation' tag and the industrial / physical-AI candidate category, and it is the only active firm by this name found doing so. Not Catamaran Ventures UK Ltd, the London arm Akshata Murty co-founded in 2013, which UKTN reported in Sept 2023 was being wound up. Not Catamaran Bio, a cell-therapy startup that turned up in search results. Phase 1 candidate data labels the firm 'western', but it is headquartered in Bengaluru, India, with a second office in Boston.

Sedemac was a secondary share purchase with undisclosed terms. The Perspectives page also links an ET piece titled 'Catamaran and SEDEMAC Forge Strategic Partnership', which may describe a further deal; it was not checked separately.
Boston office stated on the site; no address or US team details found. Partner LinkedIn URLs are not linked from the firm's site.
